title: IECCP Women's Crop Top Sports Jacket with Zip — Yoga & Fitness, Ivory Grey
short_description: Slim-fit cropped women's sports jacket by IECCP in ivory grey, with zip and thumb holes.
long_description: This long-sleeve sports jacket by IECCP has a cropped cut and is available in the colour B-Ivory Grey. According to Amazon it has a zip, a crew neck and thumb holes that keep the sleeves in place. The fit is slim. Amazon names nylon and spandex as the material, described as moisture-wicking, breathable and stretchy. According to Amazon it is suited to yoga, fitness, running, hiking and cycling and can be combined with leggings, shorts or a sports bra. The jacket weighs 230 g according to Amazon. Before buying, please check size, colour, material details and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
